fields.summary_ko.0: Buoyed by Nvidia (NVDA)'s Q3 beat, semiconductor peers AMD (AMD), Broadcom (AVGO), and TSM rose 1-2% in after-hours trading.
fields.summary_ko.1: The AI chip sector faced instability due to succession concerns, but Nvidia's solid guidance reassured market sentiment.
fields.summary_ko.2: Nvidia-backed AI infrastructure provider CoreWeave (CRWV) also rose 2%, while memory chip makers Micron (MU) and SK Hynix (SKHY) edged higher.
